_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 60 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 135,520 berths as of December 31, 2018'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2018 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands operate a combined total of 60 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 135,520 berths as of December 31, 2018'; 'Our principal competitors are Carnival Corporation & plc'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic conditions' (its own FY2018 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.43x; +15% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.68; conservative 2yr +34%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -27.1%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.4%/yr (Q4 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +32.4%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2019-11-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.43x (52.5% downside to Bear $57 / +122.5% upside to Bull $267) | Adj composite 2.46 vs market 1.78: gap +0.68 [UNDERVALUED] | +15% above the EPP floor $105 (11x FY19E $9.53) | Conservative 2-yr case: +33.5% total (+16.8%/yr) | At 12.6x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $159 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields +5.2% in Q3 2019, forward net revenue +9.21% (Q4 2019 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
